Ringleader
CR 2

XP 600
Human expert 2/warrior 2
CN Medium humanoid (human)

Languages Common
Combat Gear alchemist’s fire (2); Other Gear studded leather, club, heavy crossbow with 20 bolts, jug of cider, torches (6)
